content.comment_body: [user_name], could you please review my post titled "LWE Application will not connect to Thing in AWS"? I have followed all your recommendations, but I am unable to get a simple LWE application and LSC program functioning within AWS. The push button simply spins and fails to affect the network input in the LSC application in AWS. Thank you, [user_name]

Closed because the question was posted twice. The second thread with the subject "LWE Application will not connect to Thing in AWS" is published within the [product_name] - Software conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The main user challenge is difficulty integrating the LWE application and LSC program within AWS, as previous suggestions have not resolved the issue. Users report that interacting with the push button in the application yields no visible system response, causing frustration and a lack of feedback when attempting to trigger network input.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the LWE application and LSC program will work together smoothly in AWS, so that using the push button in the LWE app reliably triggers the required network input in the LSC app.
